name: 鱼药休药期与温度校正器

map.按实际水温校正鱼药休药期（度日模型），保障水产品食用安全: Compute the drug withdrawal period with temperature correction for fish.
map.📖 查看「鱼药休药期温度校正（度日模型）使用指南」: 📖 View the "Fish Drug Withdrawal Temperature Correction (Degree-Day Model) Guide"
map.采用度日(degree-day)模型：消除所需度日 K=标准天数×(参考温度-温: A degree-day model is used: the degree-days needed for elimination K = standard days × (reference temperature - lower temperature limit); corrected days = K ÷ (actual water temperature - lower temperature limit), and the suggested market interval is rounded up. The higher the water temperature, the faster the metabolism and the shorter the withdrawal period; below the limit the drug is metabolised very slowly, so extend the period and strengthen testing.
map.内置的五种药物标准天数（14/21/14/30/5 天 @15℃、下限 5℃）只: The built-in standard days for the five drugs (14/21/14/30/5 days @15 ℃, lower limit 5 ℃) are only example values from common labels, not authoritative caps; some drugs and regions use a higher degree-day basis (e.g. enrofloxacin is often set at 500 degree-days), so the result may be markedly shorter than local requirements. Before selling, always rely on: (1) the withdrawal period stated on the drug label; (2) local regulatory requirements; (3) residue test results.
map.水产休药期（度日模型）：度日需求 K = 标准休药期 × (参考水温 − 代谢温: Fish drug withdrawal (degree-day model): degree-day requirement K = standard withdrawal period × (reference temperature − lower metabolic temperature limit) (℃·days); corrected withdrawal = K ÷ (actual water temperature T − lower limit), with the suggested market interval rounded up; when the effective temperature is ≤0 the page warns that metabolism is extremely slow and returns; correction factor = corrected days ÷ standard days. Validation: all four inputs must be valid numbers; standard days >0, lower limit ≥0, reference temperature > lower limit, actual temperature > lower limit and ≤40 ℃; any failure clears the result with a prompt. Criteria: a rounded-up value ≤ standard days is "warmer water, shorter withdrawal", otherwise "longer withdrawal". The built-in standard days are examples only; follow the drug label and local regulations.
map.请检查输入：标准休药期须 >0；温度下限须 ≥0 且低于参考水温；实际水温须高于: Please check the inputs: standard withdrawal must be >0; the lower temperature limit must be ≥0 and below the reference temperature; the actual water temperature must be above the lower limit and no more than 40 ℃.
map.默认参数（标准休药期 14 天 @ 参考温度 15℃、温度下限 5℃、实际水温: With the default parameters (standard withdrawal period 14 days @ a reference temperature of 15 ℃, lower temperature limit 5 ℃, actual water temperature 22 ℃): the degree-day requirement K = 14×(15−5) = 140 ℃·days; the effective temperature = 22−5 = 17 ℃; the corrected withdrawal period = 140 / 17 ≈ 8.2 days, rounded up to 9 days for a safe margin, about 0.59 times the standard, shortened by the warmer water; however, if a higher degree-day basis is enforced locally (e.g. 500 degree-days), recheck with 500 degree-days. If the water temperature falls to 8 ℃, the corrected value = 140/3 ≈ 46.7 days, rounded up to 47 days, markedly longer.
map.📚 深度解析：鱼药休药期温度校正（度日模型）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Fish Drug Withdrawal Temperature Correction (Degree-Day Model)
map.出池上市前按实际水温校正休药期，确保渔药残留低于 MRL，避免药检不合格。: Before harvest and sale, correct the withdrawal period for the actual water temperature to keep drug residues below the MRL and avoid failing a drug test.
map.水温偏高时药物代谢快，可较标准休药期缩短；水温偏低（尤其接近温度下限）时大幅延长: Warmer water speeds up drug metabolism, so the period can be shorter than standard; colder water (especially near the lower limit) extends it greatly.
map.不同鱼药（恩诺沙星、土霉素、氟苯尼考、磺胺类、甲醛）按各自标准休药期与参考温度校: Different drugs (enrofloxacin, oxytetracycline, florfenicol, sulfonamides, formalin) are corrected with their own standard withdrawal period and reference temperature.
map.标准 14 天 @15℃ 在水温 22℃ 下的校正: Correcting a standard 14 days @15 ℃ at a water temperature of 22 ℃
map.默认参数（标准休药期 14 天 @ 参考温度 15℃、温度下限 5℃、实际水温: With the default parameters (standard withdrawal period 14 days @ a reference temperature of 15 ℃, lower temperature limit 5 ℃, actual water temperature 22 ℃): the degree-day requirement K = 14×(15−5) = 140 ℃·days; the effective temperature = 22−5 = 17 ℃; the corrected withdrawal period = 140 / 17 ≈ 8.2 days, about 0.59 times the standard, shortened by the warmer water. If the water temperature falls to 8 ℃, the corrected value = 140/3 ≈ 46.7 days, markedly longer.
map.度日（℃·天）衡量累积温度对药物代谢的驱动，休药期随有效温度成反比，是水产药残控: A degree-day (℃·day) measures the driving effect of accumulated temperature on drug metabolism; the withdrawal period is inversely proportional to the effective temperature, a common simplified model for drug-residue control in aquaculture.
map.水温低于下限怎么办？: What if the water temperature is below the limit?
map.实际水温必须高于温度下限，否则工具直接拒绝计算并提示参数不合理；现实中低于下限时: The actual water temperature must exceed the lower limit; otherwise the tool refuses to calculate and flags invalid parameters. In practice, metabolism below the limit is extremely slow, the formula must not be applied, and the withdrawal period should be greatly extended with residue testing.
map.内置的标准休药期可以直接用吗？: Can the built-in standard withdrawal periods be used directly?
map.不可以。内置值只是常见说明书的示例，不同药品与地区可能采用更高的度日口径（如恩诺: No. The built-in values are only examples from common labels, and different drugs and regions may use a higher degree-day basis (e.g. enrofloxacin at 500 degree-days); the page result is an estimate only, and before selling you must follow the drug label, local regulations and residue testing.
map.鱼药休药期与温度校正器 - 基于度日模型按水温校正鱼药休药期，渔业水产在线工具。: Fish Drug Withdrawal Calculator - corrects the fish drug withdrawal period for water temperature based on a degree-day model, an online fishery and aquaculture tool. A fishery and aquaculture tool that helps calculate farming parameters and yields.
map.有效温度 ≤0 时代谢极慢，工具会提示延长休药期并建议送样检测残留，不可直接套用: When the effective temperature is ≤0 metabolism is extremely slow; the tool prompts you to extend the withdrawal period and to send samples for residue testing rather than applying the formula directly.
map.默认参数（标准休药期 14 天 @ 参考温度 15℃、温度下限 5℃、实际水温: Default parameters (standard withdrawal period 14 days @ reference temperature 15℃, temperature floor 5℃, actual water temperature 22℃): degree-day requirement K = 14×(15−5) = 140 ℃·days; effective temperature = 22−5 = 17℃; corrected withdrawal period = 140 / 17 ≈ 8.2 days, and the suggested market interval is 9 days (rounded up), about 0.59× the standard, shorter at higher temperatures. If the water drops to 8℃, the correction = 140/3 ≈ 46.7 days, significantly longer.
